generated_evidence.quote_en: **Retrieval:** ACL filtering precedes generation text release; relevance never grants access. Form lexical/normalized vector queries, bound candidates, RRF merge, deterministic rerank, diversify documents/sources and cap model-context tokens. Cache keys include tenant, user-scope digest, source ACL revision, query hash and index generation. Permission change purges affected cache before TTL and next-query access remains mandatory. Error details may be safe structured validation data; **never connector credentials, full prompts, retrieved documents or unauthorized existence**. Public fields never expose secrets/raw provider credentials; diagnostics exclude documents/API secrets. Preserve uppercase codes despite unresolved “stable snake-case” convention. [Source: pp.54,64,82–84; `api:r1:c89:f2`, `api:r1:c90:f6`, `api:r1:c108:f1`, `api:r1:c137:f1`, `api:r1:c137:f21`, `api:r1:c137:f22`]

Safe structured validation details only. Diagnostic traces contain no user documents/API secrets; source text is absent from diagnostic telemetry. Policy-permitted nonessential PII redaction and default token/digest logs do not waive these prohibitions. Audit is independently retained, append-only/batch-hash chained; register SHA-256 source/revision does not select the chain algorithm. Diagnostic logs use **30-day default TTL**; security audit a separate **seven-year fictional policy**, with holds/receipts and corporate selection unresolved.
